learning_outcomes.text: Discover direct marketing applications from real life.
Understand the basic methods used in creating and managing direct marketing databases.
Measure the returns of direct marketing efforts.
Examine direct marketing methods through internet and mobile technologies.
Analyze current cases related to direct marketing.

syllabus_topics: Direct marketing concept, components of direct marketing, customer-based database marketing
Direct marketing lists and segmentation, database-driven direct marketing
Business plans, strategic plans and direct marketing plans
Creating direct marketing offers, transmission channels for offers, commercialization of offers
Creative strategies in direct marketing applications
Direct marketing media, direct mail and other print media, radio/television and other internet media
Telemarketing and telephone customer service, Internet-based direct marketing, e-communication
Direct Marketing Research, Surveys and Experiments
bibliography: Contemporary Direct Marketing, Lisa S. Spiller and Martin Baier
